description: Recovered to the A42 aircraft repair plant after 1975 and later transferred to the museum. The museum has reported the airframe as badly corroded and awaiting funding for restoration, so its display condition should be checked before relying on it.
Recovered to the A42 aircraft repair plant after 1975; A42 restored the airframe's external shape before handing it to the museum, so parts of the structure are reconstruction rather than original.
